breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 for the polar moment of inertia in all torsion formulas (both shear stress and angle of twist). The incorrect instruction to use the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in torsion relations has been completely removed, aligning with the ground truth prompt.
